title: Pointing out the stars above the residencia
caption: Laser guide stars above the Residencia, Paranal Observatory
celestial: Landscape photograph; the source does not name the site

recognition.text: ESO Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: Orange laser beams rise from Cerro Paranal into the night sky in this photograph, taken from just outside the Residencia, ESO's hotel for staff at Paranal Observatory. In the distance stands the rough outline of the Very Large Telescope (VLT) on the mountaintop, where one of the Unit Telescopes is firing its 4 Laser Guide Star Facility.

Near the ends of the beams a bright orange dot sits slightly apart from them. It looks like one point but is really four artificial stars. Each laser excites sodium atoms 90 km above the ground and makes them glow. With these artificial stars the VLT can correct for the blurring caused by turbulence in the atmosphere, which lets it produce very sharp images.
The Residencia, built in 2002, gives astronomers, engineers and other staff a place to rest, sheltered from the harsh conditions of the Atacama Desert.

understand.summary: This is a landscape photograph of Paranal Observatory at night, showing the laser beams of the VLT's 4 Laser Guide Star Facility. No camera settings are published.
understand.eye: A long camera exposure gathers more light than the eye, so the beams and the night sky may look brighter than they would to someone standing there.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.

explore: The Residencia is well known beyond astronomy. The building appeared in the James Bond film Quantum of Solace. The photograph was published as an ESO Picture of the Week, taken by N. Schafer.
alt: Orange laser beams rising from the Very Large Telescope on a distant mountaintop into the night sky, seen from outside the Residencia building.
